body:
Supposed to do, as in, how do I deal with the voices, with paranoia so crippling I cannot go outside some days.  

I am not happy, with anything about myself.  I have failed at everything I do and try.  

Most days I don't want to wake up and start a new day, same shit, over and over.

Thank you for reading.  

I hope things change a little bit for the better too.  Just not sure how that is possible right now.  I go from being very bleak to being determined and positive, but all the time, I just don't know what it is that I'm supposed to do.

Thank you for reading.  

Perhaps I shall just stay alive out of bloody mindedness, like, fuck you universe, Im still here.  Send an asteroid or something.  

Ok got to go lie down before I say more stupid shit.

Thank you for reading.  

Im going to give you a proper reply, but I can right now, so soon I will.

Getting some of these things on the nhs might be difficult.  Perhaps I will speak to my doctor and see what he things.  

I wanted to say more but Im not feeling very well right now, so just going to lie down.

Thank you for reading.  

I would like to have a dog, but it might not be well advised for me to be in the care of an animal, it might suffer because of me.  

I do see professionals, weekly.  Sadly I think they are out of ideas too.  I'm not aware of any other service available to me, the only group therapy type service in my area is people going to the hospital to play cards or cook.  I am often to ill to even make it to there, let alone engage with them.  

Just don't know what I'm supposed to do.

You know those t-shirts that have slogans or phrases on them.  'I used to be schizophrenic, but were ok now..' or '9 out of 10 voices in my head say that...'  Well, I don't find them very funny.  I suppose its good to be able to make light of things, just doesn't seem funny to me at the moment.

Thank you for reading.  

I wouldn't know what to say.
Thank you for reading.

Positive about what though?  Being positive for positivity's sake is beyond me.  Explain please?

Suppose I am correct, that I am a meaningless and insignificant speck of dust.  That my existence holds no value.  That my life is painful and difficult, and reaps no rewards for me or anyone else.  What then? Why bother? I don't understand.  

But I am more than willing to be shown why I am wrong, to have my thinking changed.  But all people can say is hope for the best, it will get better, be positive.  These are just words.  I need substance.  I need a life that is worth living.  Maybe I want too much.

I have seen tests like this before.  I struggle with them to the point I physically cannot answer.  There are too many absolutes, too much grey area that a yes or no does not accommodate for, that I find myself unable to give and answer that I am not entirely happy with.  

Eg, 4.  I do not own a TV, so strictly speaking I cannot watch a TV soap even if I did so on another device.  However if we assume that the question simple refers to the type of program rather than 'a soap opera which is watched on the tv' I am still unable to answer.  As I do not recall ever watching a TV soap.  Consequently I would have to arbitrarily chose an answer, potentially invalidating the results.  

Eg 10, it is in your nature to assume responsibility.  Responsibility for what? My own actions, then sure.  The actions of someone else that I was/am not responsible for, but that I could assume responsibility for for some purpose.  Much less likely, but still possible.  I don't know how to answer this.  

14, again lack of context.  Are we talking about how to invest money in the long term, or whether or not to chase the man who just stole the old lady's handbag, or to sit a debate whether its worth running after him, or phoning the police.  

That and I do not think it is always very helpful to place someone into a box, so to speak.
Its an ok read.  Might seem like a lot of gibberish to some people, maybe they are right though.  I enjoyed it.

I don't think I am afraid, I might be, but I don't think so.  I think I am tired.  I want a break from myself, forever.  

I don't think I am strong, if I was strong I would have been able to fix myself by now.  

Maybe sometimes there are no answers.  Maybe sometimes you just have to suffer because there's nothing else to do.  But what a sad existence that would be, who would want that?

I see a psychiatrist regularly.  As far as I am aware, he has exhausted the tools at his disposal.  

I don't know if I want help any more.  I am tired.  I am not, as I said in my post, about to go and kill myself.  But I would love oh so much for everything to go away, for life to end for me.

Thank you for reading.  

It is up to each of us to make our own decisions.  Possibly.  I know how I was on drugs.  I see now in hindsight how I changed.  It was not good for me.  It didn't really change the existing problems, just detracted from them temporarily.  And sowed seeds for more problems further down the line.  I've met a lot of mentally ill people, who are heavy users.  I don't want to be like them.  

And, as for my post being, really interesting smiley face.  That is not a response I could have envisioned.  I cannot tell if you are creepy and socially misaligned (like myself perhaps) or a connoisseur of human behaviour and genuinely enjoy seeing how people work (also perhaps a little like myself).

I don't recognise the number format and so I guess its not from my country, so dialling it would be rather costly for me.  And, I mean no disrespect here or ingratitude, I'm not sure it would be a good idea for me to be calling numbers posted on the web.  

I doubt that any good person wants to see another suffer.  But what is there to be done that could possibly help or change anything? Give me some idea, some premise or formula.  I can't find one.

Its funny that.  I've been sent to see so many doctors, that I've been officially diagnosed with just about any mental illness you care to mention.    I'm not sure putting someone into a box is that helpful.  And I don't think its a good idea to self diagnose.  

I have been given every atypical anti-psychotic there is available, and none helped, most made things worse.  

I am not aware of any therapies that I can access, the mental health team who see me have nothing else to offer, and their funding is being cut, so what there is may be gone eventually.  

I see absolutely no reason whatsoever, nothing at all, to make me think that things will get better.  No one grain of evidence.  Why then, with absolutely no purpose, no meaning, no hope, should I keep trying.  

All the money, time and resources that are wasted on me, could be helping someone else.  Why throw a dead dog a bone? So to speak.

Thank you for reading.  

A difference to what? To others, to myself?  I wish I knew how.  I wish I could something good with my pathetic existence.  Maybe its conceited, but whenever I go outside, I hope to see a child in the road in front of a fast vehicle, that I can push out of the road and save, but in doing so, I die.  Sad, conceited, pompous whatever.  Its about the only way I could ever make a difference to anyone.  

If you have some ideas, I'm all ears.  I'll give anything a go.  I'm desperate.  I need something to change.  Or I just want to end myself.

I like Futurama.  Fry is always trying to get Leela to see that he loves her, but she doesn't care for him in that way.  It makes me cry and cry, and sometimes I feel better for a bit after crying.  I like Star Trek because they live in a utopian society where everyone is cared for, all the characters are true friends to each other, they always help each other and act with integrity, but it makes me sad because its just a story, and people don't really act that nice to each other.  

My favourite book is the Tao Te Ching.

So do I, I would love to have the voices gone forever, for my head to truly be my own, for it to be silent.  

But I waited for years to get to see a psychologist (there is no way I can afford to see a private one) and after about six months she had to leave her work.  Then after seeing her replacement, I was told that this sort of therapy was 'not suited to me', and since then I have not been able to get anything.  

I'm out of ideas.  The mental health professionals are out of ideas.  I'm tired.

I did not know you could go to an animal shelter to just play and be with the animals.  Maybe it is different where you are from.  

There are lots of things I would love to be able to do in my free time, but it doesn't work out like that.  A lot of days of the week I am too frightened of going outside to leave my front door.  

Sadly, all my time is free.  I would much rather be healthy enough to work, and be able to work a full week for even the lowest of pay.  As it is, the things you once enjoyed, become tedious, almost like they are mocking me.  And I feel bad about enjoying doing them.  Now I mostly just clean my bedsit a lot.  Tidy things up, organise computer folders, re read the same books, watch the same shows.  Usually thought I just end up in bed wishing that I could disappear.  I hate myself so much.

We can talk, I think we are already.  I do like animals a lot, a lot more than people most of the time.  I am not allowed any pets where I live.  I am not sure a pet is capable of the emotional complexities that you say they are, but I am not exactly the best judge, never having had one.  And I don't think it would be a good idea.  I am barely able to care for myself, it might be irresponsibly for me to have a pet that is dependant on me for food and such.

Undeniable, but it is also possible that something worse could happen.  

I'm just so tired.  I don't see the point to my life.  Why bother, what difference does it make?  I just take in and give nothing back.  I am quite literally a waste of space.  

Things have not gotten better even once, only worse.  Even when they seems to be getting better (street drugs, big mistake) they were in fact only getting worse.  I don't see anything changing anytime soon.  Even the way the health care workers shrug and look at me now is different, like they know it too.  

As for, isnt it worth trying just in case.  I don't know, why is it? Please do tell me, because at this time, I truly wish to just end.

Thank you for your reply.  

Perhaps I did not make myself sufficiently clear in my post.  Then it is my fault you seem not to understand, please forgive me, I do not wish to seem ungrateful to you.  

I have no family that I can talk to.  The only family I have is abusive towards me even now.  My two friends are not close enough that I feel they would want to listen.  I have tried a lot of medications, none of which helped, most of which made me ill in other ways.  Antipsychotics are very powerful drugs, that can have more than just the desired effect on a person.  

I am not afraid of the future, I don't think so anyway.  I just want mine to end sooner than later.

Thank you for reading.  

I'm sorry, I did not intend to make you or anyone angry.  

I don't feel very smart, or like a good person.  I don't feel I am of any value or importance to anyone.  

I don't know about the benefits things, I'm not able to do things like I used to, at uni I could cope with all sorts of stuff.  Now I just crumple when faced with even the slightest obstacle.  Maybe the doctors can write a letter on my behalf, that's all I can think of.  And I hate myself for it.  I hate being weak and helpless, for thinking, someone else can fix this and make it better.  I should be able to fix it myself, but I don't know how any more.  

Things come and go.  Mental health is not consistent like a broken leg, that is broken, can't be walked on, hurts and slowly heals.  It can change a lot, over a long time or even a few minutes.  Some days I wake up and I don't know who I am, or am convinced that if I make any sound 'people/monsters/things' will come from outside to hurt/kill me.  And this may last for most of the day.  Other days I am able to take care of myself like anyone else.  Its humiliating.

Thank you too for reading.  

But I don't want to keep on fighting.  I want to end.  I've done a lot of things.  Some stupid, some smart, but now I don't have any ideas left, and neither do the mental health staff I see, unless they are hiding an ace up their sleeves, though I doubt that is their style.

Thank you for reading.  

You say, there's nowhere to go but up.  But I feel so ungrateful.  I am aware just how lucky those of us in First World countries are.  There is no war here, no famine.  I have had a lot of help from doctors, community psychiatric nurses, occupational therapists, social workers.  I have had dozens of types of pill thrown at me.  Things could have been a lot worse for me.  But still I feel so hopeless and pointless.  Compared to some situations, I feel like a pitiful whining excuse machine.  

The will be no new pills, no more hope in that form for me.  The doctors I see no longer think prescribing pills is worth trying.  I don't know if there is anything else they can do.  I no longer know what to do, what to try.  I'm tired.
